estimand: DeltaR is the paired difference between equal-unit mean REF-event retention for repaired B and existing B on the same fixed REF cohort
proposed_rule: DeltaR >= 0.05 and one-sided paired-unit bootstrap lower95 > 0
assessment: unsuitable if interpreted as 95% evidence for a minimum meaningful effect of 0.05
concrete_issue: The proposed rule can pass when the confidence bound includes effects arbitrarily close to zero and below 0.05. For example, DeltaR=0.051 and lower95=0.001 passes the proposal but does not support a 0.05 minimum effect.
why_replacement_matches_claim: The complete one-sided 95% interval then excludes every effect at or below the declared minimum meaningful effect.

bootstrap.resample: sample REF-unit delta-retentions with replacement; retain existing/repaired dependence within each unit
bootstrap.scope: composition sensitivity for the fixed observed REF cohort
does_not_cover: shared physiological or artifact dependence across units

dependence_assessment.handled: Existing and repaired retention for one REF unit remain paired in every bootstrap draw.
dependence_assessment.not_handled: Units may share state, noise, drift, and sorting artifacts; an ordinary unit bootstrap treats their observed delta rows as exchangeable composition units.
dependence_assessment.interpretation_limit: Call the bound a fixed-cohort unit-composition robustness bound, not a population or repeated-experiment confidence interval.

power_and_margin_scope.margin_origin: supplied before redesigned cross-arm outcomes; not calibrated from a repaired-arm result
power_and_margin_scope.numeric_power_claim: none; no outcome-blind variance estimate for unit deltas was supplied
power_and_margin_scope.worst_case_note: Because per-unit deltas lie in [-1,1], their standard deviation can be as large as 1. With 61 independent units, a normal worst-case one-sided uncertainty allowance is about 1.645/sqrt(61)=0.211, so a lower bound above 0.05 could require a point effect near 0.261 in that extreme case.
power_and_margin_scope.decision: retain 0.05 only as the pre-outcome minimum meaningful effect; do not claim it is powered until an outcome-blind variance/power plan is approved
